name: openGym Plus
subtitle: An unofficial build of openGym with extra features
description: openGym Plus: an unofficial build of openGym (github.com/DuarteSantos8/openGym) with extra features, not affiliated with the original project. AGPL-3.0-or-later.

apps.name: openGym Plus
apps.subtitle: Self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker
apps.localizedDescription: An unofficial build of openGym with extra features: a Health area with Apple Health and RENPHO, a music bar, machine settings and photos per exercise, health widgets on Home, Settings as a tab. Not affiliated with the original project. AGPL-3.0-or-later; source at github.com/TheBlackSide243/openGym.

versions.localizedDescription: RENPHO: sign-in fixed (RENPHO changed it in October), and an optional second account so the RENPHO app stays signed in. · RENPHO: accesso di nuovo funzionante e secondo account facoltativo.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Used to show the song the Music app is playing at the top of a workout, with buttons to pause it or skip to the next one.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to scan your gym membership QR code, and to take a photo or video of an exercise you add yourself.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Used to make sure it’s really you before your account is deleted.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Used to show your heart rate on your Apple Watch while you train, next to each set, and the Health data you choose in openGym's Health section.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Used to save your finished workouts and weigh-ins to Apple Health, when you switch it on.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to reach your own openGym server or AI model on your home network, when you connect one.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used to record the sound of a video you take of an exercise you add yourself.
